compatibility.reason.ADULT_MALE_BETTA_CO: Multiple adult male {source} cannot share this tank.
House adult males in separate suitable systems. Do not rely on a larger group or individual temperament.
compatibility.reason.ADULT_SPACE_INSUFFI: The adult space requirement for {source} is not met at {target}.
Use a tank that meets adult length, height and usable swimming-space requirements, or choose a suitable species.
compatibility.reason.ADULT_SPACE_UNKNOWN: The adult space requirement or available space for {source} at {target} is unverified.
Confirm adult requirements and usable space after substrate and hardscape displacement. Juveniles still require an adult plan.
compatibility.reason.BETTA_CONSPECIFIC_C: No multiple-adult-male rule was triggered for {source}, but this same-species group still has unmet review conditions.
Review individuals, sex, space, cover and management. Prepare immediate separation; V0 defaults to one individual.
compatibility.reason.BETTA_SEX_OR_STAGE_: Sex or life stage is unknown for {source}; adult male conflict cannot be ruled out.
Confirm the sex and life stage of every individual before approving a same-species combination.
compatibility.reason.BOTTOM_SIFTER_FOOD_: Appropriate sinking food for {source} has not been confirmed.
Provide species-appropriate sinking food. Feces and leftovers are not an adequate feeding plan.
compatibility.reason.BOTTOM_SIFTER_NEEDS: No appropriate sinking-food plan is present for {source}.
Provide suitable sinking food and observe feeding. Bottom-sifting fish are not feces cleaners.
The modeled soft-sand foraging requirement of {source} is unmet.
Provide a safe, accessible soft-sand foraging area and reassess. Sifting does not remove the need for waste management.
compatibility.reason.BOTTOM_SIFTER_SUBST: The foraging substrate for {source} is unverified.
Confirm a safe soft-sand substrate for this bottom-sifting profile.
compatibility.reason.COMMUNITY_RANGE_EMP: The whole-community water-parameter intersection is empty; {source} and {target} define conflicting bounds.
Separate incompatible species or remove a conflicting member, then recompute the entire combination. A freshwater label is insufficient.
compatibility.reason.COMMUNITY_WATER_TYP: Separate freshwater, brackish and saltwater requirements into suitable systems; do not invent a compromise water type.
compatibility.reason.CONTENT_POLICY_UNKN: The V0 purchasing policy for {source} is unknown.
Have the content owner confirm purchasable_v0, planned or reference_only.
compatibility.reason.DIRECTIONAL_FIN_NIP: {source} may nip the fins of {target}; source group size is {source_count}. This is a risk, not a guaranteed attack.
Prefer separating the fin-nipping source and long-finned target. Review group size, space and stress; adequate numbers do not guarantee safety.
compatibility.reason.GAPE_PREDATION_RISK: The gape of {source} is not smaller than the body cross-section of {target}; size-related predation is possible.
Separate potential prey or use a dedicated nursery. Cover does not guarantee survival; reassess as animals grow.
compatibility.reason.INCONSISTENT_SPECIE: The same species ID {source} uses inconsistent profile instances.
Reference one reviewed profile version for all cohorts of the same species.
compatibility.reason.INVALID_STOCK_GROUP: {target} has a missing species/group ID, duplicate group ID, or a non-positive count.
Provide a reviewed species, unique group ID and positive integer count, then reassess.
compatibility.reason.NO_VALID_STOCK.mess: No valid stock group is available for assessment.
compatibility.reason.NO_VALID_STOCK.repa: Add at least one reviewed species cohort; an empty or invalid composition is not an approval.
compatibility.reason.PREDATION_PROFILE_U: The ability of {source} to prey on smaller animals is unverified.
Confirm diet and size-related predation capability. Do not infer safety or total loss from fish/shrimp categories.
compatibility.reason.PREDATION_SIZE_UNKN: Gape or current body cross-section data for {source} and {target} is missing; swallowing risk is unresolved.
Confirm current-stage gape and body cross-section, and separate potential prey until verified.
compatibility.reason.SAME_SPECIES_GROUP_: {source} has {source_count} individuals, below its recommended same-species minimum of {required_count}. Other fish or shrimp do not count.
After reassessing space, filtration and conflicts, add the same species or choose a species with different social requirements.
compatibility.reason.SPECIES_GROUP_MIN_U: The same-species group requirement for {source} is unknown.
Verify social and conspecific-isolation requirements instead of substituting other species.
compatibility.reason.SPECIES_RANGE_UNKNO: The reviewed {parameter} range for {source} is missing or invalid.
Confirm the complete species range and reassess. Do not treat unknown data as a compatible freshwater default.
compatibility.reason.SPECIES_WATER_TYPE_: The water system required by {source} is unverified.
Confirm the species water system; unknown must not default to freshwater.
compatibility.reason.TANK_PARAMETER_OUTS: The current tank {parameter} is outside the reviewed range for {source}.
If a whole-community range exists, adjust gradually into its interior. Otherwise separate species; avoid sudden parameter changes.
compatibility.reason.TANK_PARAMETER_UNKN: The current tank measurement for {parameter} is missing or invalid.
Measure and record the current value; compatible species ranges do not prove current water conditions are suitable.
compatibility.reason.TANK_WATER_TYPE_MIS: {source} requires a different water system from the current tank.
Move the species into a suitable independent water system.
compatibility.reason.TANK_WATER_TYPE_UNK: The current tank water system is unknown.
Confirm whether this is a freshwater, brackish or saltwater system.
compatibility.reason.V0_CONTENT_NOT_PURC: {source} is planned or reference-only and cannot be purchased in V0. This is content policy, not an ecological incompatibility claim.
Remove it from the V0 purchase list or wait for an approved content version.
compatibility.summary.action_required: Review every blocking, risk, unmet-condition and unverified-data reason. Resolve and reassess before introduction.
compatibility.summary.monitor: No modeled conflict found. Quarantine, staged introduction, monitoring and an isolation plan are still required.
